nonNegotiableCompletionRule: No student-visible Admin/source mutation is complete merely because its canonical source write succeeded. Creating a batch is distinct from creating a student login. A generic SQL constraint failure must never be presented as a duplicate batch. Portal Login Details Find remains read-only. Reset & Show New Credentials is a separate deliberate action that may replace only the normal student's Login and Answer Pack credential fields and must preserve batches, entitlements, sessions and account state. Frontend module paths must be verified in browser-relative context. Parent-email test routing must never consume live-parent idempotency. Equivalent Maths Year/L-level cards must not be duplicated in the final student home response or after browser rendering. The ordinary Year 6 teaching card must be labelled Year 6, never Lessons, while SATS remains a separate presentation under the existing access rules. L3 SATS must be driven by genuine SATS access, not shared canonical Year 6 content. Where canonical batch definitions exist, access classification must use them rather than batch-code naming heuristics. A deployed marker is not a substitute for owner browser verification. Production recovery must never roll back later valid changes. A lesson-video mutation is not complete until the current prepared lesson stream variant also read-backs the exact new ScreenPal ID; a canonical LESSONS_KV write alone is insufficient. The live V2 Year 6 lesson list must be corrected at the final browser boundary by the standalone cache-busted visible-code DOM guard: Y6TnMm term-first then lesson-number and Y6SMn/Y6MSn numerically; a DOM mutation must not be able to leave the list out of order. Owner browser evidence is required before CLOSED PASS. For this Year 6 ordering incident specifically, the last known working September mechanism is authoritative: a standalone, index-loaded, cache-busted visible-code DOM guard with MutationObserver. Do not replace it with an in-bundle-only implementation. Production frontend deployment must target the active Browser Worker ASSETS path and must verify the live hostname serves the exact guard asset. The 226.futureperfect.education marketing-video page is intentionally public and isolated: it must not acquire Portal authentication, Portal/Quiz service bindings, D1/KV/R2 bindings, or autoplay unless separately authorised. Parent-facing URL continuity takes precedence over the underlying video provider, so a future provider migration should preserve 226.futureperfect.education. The 11plus.futureperfect.education marketing-video page is intentionally public and isolated: it must not acquire Portal authentication, Portal/Quiz service bindings, D1/KV/R2 bindings, or autoplay unless separately authorised. Parent-facing URL continuity takes precedence over the underlying video provider, so a future provider migration should preserve 11plus.futureperfect.education.
